items.name: kb-retriever
items.author: ConardLi
items.description: Let their coding agent intelligently query a local knowledge base of Markdown, PDFs, and Excel files without flooding the context window.
items.summary: The kb-retriever skill searches a local knowledge directory with layered data_structure.md indexes and progressive retrieval instead of loading whole files. Default root is knowledge/ under the project unless the user specifies another path; confirm location with test -d before using Glob. Traverse index files top-down, pick relevant subdirectories and files, then grep and partial Read with limits. PDF and Excel require reading references/pdf_reading.md and references/excel_reading.md plus excel_analysis.md before processing; extract text to files rather than stdout for large PDFs. Markdown and text use targeted grep with local Read windows. Excel uses pandas with nrows limits and column-aware filtering. A unified five-iteration search loop broadens keywords and stops when enough context exists or attempts exhaust. Answers cite source files and flag uncertainty rather than inventing facts. Network search is forbidden during knowledge base queries. The skill supports Chinese and English responses with conclusion-first formatting and explicit missing-info handling when the vault lacks matching content.
highlights: Hierarchical data_structure.md indexes guide directory traversal before file reads.
Mandatory PDF and Excel reference reads before pdfplumber or pandas processing.
Progressive grep and partial Read; never load entire large files at once.
Five-iteration keyword broadening loop with explicit stop and uncertainty rules.
Default knowledge/ root with test -d verification; no network search allowed.

highlights: pandas/scikit-learn-style API over BigQuery.
Stay-in-cloud transformation best practices.
